brief: Row of three-storey 19th-century brick commercial buildings on the main river street: tall narrow windows with stone hoods, bracketed and corbelled cornices, and a run of small shop fronts; the courthouse tower rises behind.

facade.notes: Front Street, Marietta: the side of a two-storey Colonial Revival brick office with a big end chimney, a lawn with trees, a vinyl privacy fence screening a parking lot; the courthouse clock tower and a school beyond
